en: Vintage multi-view postcard with sepia and pastel-colored illustrations of several city landmarks arranged decoratively with flowers and a heraldic shield. The main upper-right view shows a market square with the town hall, church tower, colonnaded building, people walking, and horse-drawn carriages. Other inset views depict a domed cathedral, the ornate interior of St. Simeon Cathedral, a girls' gymnasium (school) building, and a small chapel among trees. Text in German labels the views and the city name "Mitau" appears prominently on the front.
